sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即使是在黑胶唱片盛行的年代，我每晚去夜店打碟时，都要带上300件我最珍视的宝贝，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，陈列着这些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼出品的《重构者》吧。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, President Trump is calling for an overhaul of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普总统呼吁对美国

sentences.en: immigration system to replace family-based migration with merit-based migration.
sentences.zh: 移民体系进行彻底改革，用基于能力的移民制度取代基于家庭关系的移民制度。

sentences.en: But what counts as merit?
sentences.zh: 但什么才算“能力”呢？

sentences.en: And the school shooting in Florida.
sentences.zh: 还有佛罗里达州的校园枪击案。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月15日，星期四。

sentences.en: It's now Wednesday morning of the week the Senate set aside to debate DACA, border security, interior enforcement, and other immigration issues.
sentences.zh: 现在是周三上午，参议院已将本周定为辩论“童年抵美者暂缓遣返计划”（DACA）、边境安全、国内执法及其他移民议题的时间。

sentences.en: Caitlin, what's been going on in the Senate this week?
sentences.zh: 凯特琳，参议院这周都在忙些什么？

sentences.en: The Senate has taken this really unusual step of engaging in a kind of unmitigated hashing out of all things immigration.
sentences.zh: 参议院采取了一个非常罕见的举措，即对所有移民相关议题进行彻底且毫无保留的讨论。

sentences.en: Caitlin Dickerson covers immigration for The Times.
sentences.zh: 凯特琳·迪克森是《时报》的移民问题记者。

sentences.en: And that's because in order to convince Democrats to reopen the government, last month Mitch McConnell agreed to an open debate, so that's what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 这是因为为了说服民主党人重启政府，米奇·麦康奈尔上个月同意进行公开辩论，所以他们现在就在做这件事。

sentences.en: I promised I would clear the way to debate these matters this week, and I have.
sentences.zh: 我承诺过会为本周辩论这些事项扫清障碍，我做到了。

sentences.en: I promised I would ensure a fair amendment process in which both sides could offer legislation for discussion and votes, and I have.
sentences.zh: 我承诺过会确保一个公平的修正案程序，让双方都能提出立法建议进行讨论和投票，我也做到了。

sentences.en: Everyone should be focused on finding a bill to protect the DREAMers and address border security that can get 60 votes.
sentences.zh: 每个人都应该专注于寻找一项既能保护“追梦人”，又能解决边境安全问题，且能获得60票支持的法案。

sentences.en: That's the ballgame.
sentences.zh: 这才是关键所在。

sentences.en: The goal is to build a new immigration policy from scratch, so something that deals with DREAMers, but also if the Republicans get their way,
sentences.zh: 目标是从零开始构建一套新的移民政策，既要处理“追梦人”问题，但如果共和党人如愿以偿，

sentences.en: the deal would involve a lot more than that.
sentences.zh: 那么这项协议涉及的内容将远不止于此。

sentences.en: It could, in fact, overhaul our entire immigration system.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它可能会彻底重塑我们整个移民体系。

sentences.en: Our legal immigration system as well.
sentences.zh: 包括我们的合法移民体系。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what would that mean, the change that Republicans are envisioning of our legal immigration system?
sentences.zh: 那么，共和党人所设想的对合法移民体系的改革意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, the biggest thing that it means is a shift away from the core of our current immigration system, which is family-based acceptance, family ties.
sentences.zh: 嗯，最核心的意义在于，我们将从当前移民体系的核心——即基于家庭关系的准入和家庭纽带——转向其他模式。

sentences.en: You know, right now we allow about a million people into the country every year, and about 800,000 of them or two-thirds are allowed in based on who they're related to.
sentences.zh: 你知道，目前我们每年允许大约一百万人入境，其中约80万人，也就是三分之二，是基于亲属关系获准入境的。

sentences.en: That's really what makes up the bulk of who we allow into the country.
sentences.zh: 这确实构成了我们允许入境人口的大部分。

sentences.en: And the idea that Republicans are hoping to sell Democrats on is to really limit, if not totally get rid of visas that are based on family ties,
sentences.zh: 共和党人希望说服民主党人接受的观点是，限制甚至完全取消基于家庭关系的签证，

sentences.en: and to focus instead on employment skills, on education, and on factors that they believe are going to clearly benefit the American economy.
sentences.zh: 转而关注就业技能、教育水平，以及他们认为能明显造福美国经济的因素。

sentences.en: We will have so many more benefits.
sentences.zh: 我们将获得更多的好处。

sentences.en: It will save countless dollars, raise workers' wages, and help struggling families, including immigrant families, enter the middle class.
sentences.zh: 这将节省无数资金，提高工人薪资，并帮助包括移民家庭在内的困难家庭进入中产阶级。

sentences.en: And they will do it quickly.
sentences.zh: 而且他们会很快实现这一目标。

sentences.en: And they will be very, very happy indeed.
sentences.zh: 他们确实会感到非常、非常高兴。

sentences.en: So how does this system of family-based migration, how does it actually work?
sentences.zh: 那么，这种基于家庭关系的移民体系到底是如何运作的呢？

sentences.en: So the system allows people to petition to bring family members into the country, specific types of family members.
sentences.zh: 该系统允许人们申请将家庭成员带入美国，仅限于特定类型的家庭成员。

sentences.en: So young children, but also in some cases adult children who are married, siblings, and parents.
sentences.zh: 比如年幼的孩子，但在某些情况下也包括已婚的成年子女、兄弟姐妹和父母。

sentences.en: But it's not as if you just apply and anybody who falls into one of those categories is ushered in.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是说你只要申请，任何符合这些类别的人都能被接纳。

sentences.en: The sponsor has to prove that they make a certain amount of money so that this person who is coming into the United States is going to be supported, that they're not going to be
sentences.zh: 担保人必须证明他们有足够的收入，以确保这位进入美国的人能得到供养，不会成为

sentences.en: a drag on the economy.
sentences.zh: 经济上的负担。

sentences.en: And then each of those categories is subject to limits.
sentences.zh: 此外，每一个类别都受到名额限制。

sentences.en: So just because, again, you qualify as somebody whose family member has enough money and as a sibling or a child of an American citizen, you also are going to have to wait in line.
sentences.zh: 所以，即使你符合条件，有亲属拥有足够的资金，且你是美国公民的兄弟姐妹或子女，你也必须排队等待。

sentences.en: And in many cases, those lines are years and years long.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，这些队伍长达数年。

sentences.en: And they can even be decades long.
sentences.zh: 甚至可能长达数十年。

sentences.en: So it sounds like you're saying there are limitations on this.
sentences.zh: 听起来你是说这其中存在限制。

sentences.en: It's not an open-door system to family.
sentences.zh: 这并不是一个对家庭成员敞开大门的系统。

sentences.en: But in essence, this is a system built around the idea that eventually you can have a lot of your family, maybe even most of your family, join you in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但本质上，这个系统的建立理念是，最终你可以让你的许多家人，甚至大部分家人，都到美国与你团聚。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And, you know, people have looked back at three and four generations and seen a single immigrant bring in more than 100 people.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，人们回顾三四代人的情况，会发现一个移民可以带来超过100名亲属。

sentences.en: And this may be responsible for the name that President Trump likes to use to describe this system, which is controversial,
sentences.zh: 这可能就是特朗普总统喜欢用来描述这个体系的名称的由来，虽然这个名称颇具争议，

sentences.en: chain migration.
sentences.zh: 即“链式移民”。

sentences.en: Chain migration, exactly.
sentences.zh: 链式移民，没错。

sentences.en: Chain migration.
sentences.zh: 链式移民。

sentences.en: Chain migration.
sentences.zh: 链式移民。

sentences.en: Chain migration.
sentences.zh: 链式移民。

sentences.en: Ending chain migration.
sentences.zh: 终结链式移民。

sentences.en: How common is this system you're describing around the world, outside the United States?
sentences.zh: 你所描述的这种体系在世界其他国家，即美国以外的地方，有多普遍？

sentences.en: It's not common at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不普遍。

sentences.en: I mean, lots of other countries, they do allow some people based on family ties.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，许多其他国家确实允许部分人基于家庭关系入境。

sentences.en: But even in places that do, the American definition of family is much broader than it is elsewhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 但即使在这些国家，美国对“家庭”的定义也比世界其他地方宽泛得多。

sentences.en: Other countries don't consider, you know, an adult child necessarily an eligible family member or a sibling an eligible family member.
sentences.zh: 其他国家并不一定认为成年子女是符合条件的家庭成员，或者兄弟姐妹是符合条件的家庭成员。

sentences.en: So we are the most generous country when it comes to family-based immigration.
sentences.zh: 所以，在基于家庭的移民方面，我们是世界上最慷慨的国家。

sentences.en: So why do we do it this way?
sentences.zh: 那么我们为什么要这样做呢？

sentences.en: Why would our immigration policy be based on anything other than what's theoretically best for our economy?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们的移民政策要基于除“理论上对经济最有利”之外的其他考量？

sentences.en: This bill that we will sign today is not a revolutionary bill.
sentences.zh: 我们今天签署的这项法案并非革命性的法案。

sentences.en: It does not affect the lives of millions.
sentences.zh: 它不会影响数百万人的生活。

sentences.en: Yet it is still one of the most important acts of this Congress
sentences.zh: 然而，它仍然是本届国会

sentences.en: and of this administration.
sentences.zh: 和本届政府最重要的法案之一。

sentences.en: What's interesting is that when family-based immigration was introduced in 1965, it comes along with a sort of surprising goal in mind, which is to keep the United States
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，当基于家庭的移民政策在1965年出台时，它背后隐藏着一个令人惊讶的目标，那就是保持美国

sentences.en: primarily white, primarily, you know, European.
sentences.zh: 主要是白人，主要是欧洲裔。

sentences.en: And this measure that we will sign today will really make us truer to ourselves both as a country and as a people.
sentences.zh: 而我们今天签署的这项措施，将使我们作为一个国家和民族，更忠实于我们自己。

sentences.en: It will strengthen us in a hundred
sentences.zh: 它将以一百种

sentences.en: unseen ways.
sentences.zh: 看不见的方式增强我们的实力。

sentences.en: Before that, we had quotas that were based on country of origin.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，我们有基于原籍国的配额制度。

sentences.en: Under that system, the ability of new immigrants to come to America
sentences.zh: 在该制度下，新移民进入美国的能力

sentences.en: depended upon the country of their birth.
sentences.zh: 取决于他们的出生国。

sentences.en: And those were then considered during the 1960 civil rights movement to be raciSt.
sentences.zh: 而在20世纪60年代的民权运动期间，这些被认为是种族主义的。

sentences.en: Men of needed skill and talent were denied entrance because they came from Southern or Eastern Europe or from one of the developing continents.
sentences.zh: 拥有必要技能和才华的人因为来自南欧、东欧或发展中大陆而被拒绝入境。

sentences.en: And so we moved away from a quota system and yet created another system that was intended to maintain the racial makeup of the country, the demographic makeup of the country.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们放弃了配额制度，却又创建了另一个旨在维持国家种族构成和人口构成的体系。

sentences.en: But of course, shortly after, immigration patterns shift and we see a lot more people coming to the United States from basically everywhere except Europe.
sentences.zh: 但当然，不久之后，移民模式发生了转变，我们看到大量人口从除欧洲以外的几乎所有地方涌入美国。

sentences.en: And so, you know, as a result, this policy starts to really propel dramatic change in terms of demographics in the opposite direction that it was intended to
sentences.zh: 结果，这项政策开始推动人口结构发生剧烈变化，其方向与政策出台时

sentences.en: when it was introduced.
sentences.zh: 所预期的恰恰相反。

sentences.en: So this is really interesting,
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣，

sentences.en: Kaylin.
sentences.zh: 凯琳。

sentences.en: When the president made his now infamous shithole comment, he was talking about doing away with aspects of our immigration system that result in people from poorer countries
sentences.zh: 当总统发表他那番臭名昭著的“粪坑”言论时，他谈到的是要废除我们移民体系中那些导致来自贫穷国家的人，

sentences.en: or people without high-end economic value coming to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 或者没有高端经济价值的人进入美国的部分。

sentences.en: And that's also, it sounds like, what he's thinking about with this shift away from a family-based system to a merit-based system.
sentences.zh: 听起来，他想从基于家庭的体系转向基于能力的体系，也是出于同样的考虑。

sentences.en: But it feels like what you're saying is that that's what the creators of the family-based system wanted as well when that system was created.
sentences.zh: 但你刚才的意思似乎是，这正是当年创建基于家庭的体系的人所希望的结果。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It does the exact opposite of what the architects of the policy hoped for.
sentences.zh: 它产生的结果与政策制定者的初衷完全相反。

sentences.en: And as a result, the country has become a lot more brown.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，这个国家的有色人种比例大大增加了。

sentences.en: So with that in mind, would a merit-based system, this thing that
sentences.zh: 那么考虑到这一点，基于能力的体系，也就是

sentences.en: President Trump says he wants, would it actually accomplish his stated goal of bringing immigrants with higher economic value than the family-based system it would replace?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统所说他想要的，真的能实现他宣称的目标吗？即引入比它所取代的基于家庭的体系具有更高经济价值的移民？

sentences.en: It could.
sentences.zh: 有可能。

sentences.en: It depends on what the merit-based system looks like because all that means in general is that as a country, you decide on factors that are important to you in terms of
sentences.zh: 这取决于基于能力的体系具体是什么样，因为总的来说，这意味着作为一个国家，你要决定哪些因素对你来说是重要的，

sentences.en: who you want to bring in.
sentences.zh: 来决定你想引入什么样的人。

sentences.en: You assign each of those factors some degree of weight and then you use that sort of rubric to decide who gets a ticket in and who doesn't.
sentences.zh: 你为这些因素分配一定的权重，然后利用这套标准来决定谁能获得入境许可，谁不能。

sentences.en: But when President Trump talks about a merit-based system, he's being a lot more specific than that.
sentences.zh: 但当特朗普总统谈论基于能力的体系时，他要具体得多。

sentences.en: He actually means fewer overall immigrants and then of that much smaller number of people we allow in, a much larger proportion of them being people who have high skills, doctors,
sentences.zh: 他实际上是指减少移民总数，而在我们允许入境的少数人中，很大一部分人必须是高技能人才，比如医生、

sentences.en: engineers,
sentences.zh: 工程师、

sentences.en: PhDs, entrepreneurs, more immigrants who can slide into the upper echelons of the American economy and of American society.
sentences.zh: 博士、企业家，更多能进入美国经济和社会上层的移民。

sentences.en: And so if we think about his definition of merit-based, then yes, that will be the result.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们按照他对“基于能力”的定义来看，那么是的，结果会是那样。

sentences.en: So we've been discussing this kind of philosophical question of what immigration is for.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在讨论关于“移民是为了什么”这一哲学问题。

sentences.en: And this seems to be another philosophical question.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是另一个哲学问题。

sentences.en: What is merit?
sentences.zh: 什么是能力？

sentences.en: And having high skills is just one way to think about it.
sentences.zh: 拥有高技能只是其中的一种考量方式。

sentences.en: But it sounds like that's how President Trump is thinking about merit.
sentences.zh: 但听起来特朗普总统就是这样看待能力的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, I think one thing that's actually getting lost in this debate is that there's research that shows that people who have family ties actually fare better in the economy
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这场辩论中被忽略的一点是，有研究表明，拥有家庭纽带的人在经济上表现得更好，

sentences.en: because they have a built-in safety net.
sentences.zh: 因为他们有内置的安全网。

sentences.en: So if you move to America and you have family members here, you have someone who you can stay with if you don't have anywhere to live.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你搬到美国，这里有你的家人，当你没有地方住的时候，你就有可以投靠的人。

sentences.en: You have someone who can take you to the DMV, who can show you how to file taxes, who might help you learn the language and understand the culture.
sentences.zh: 有人可以带你去车管所，教你如何报税，甚至可能帮你学习语言和了解文化。

sentences.en: So there's definitely an economic argument that says people with family ties are actually going to do even better than somebody who's a PhD or who has millions of dollars
sentences.zh: 因此，绝对有一种经济论点认为，拥有家庭纽带的人实际上会比那些拥有博士学位或拥有数百万美元

sentences.en: to contribute to the economy but who doesn't have anybody to help them on a rainy day when things go wrong.
sentences.zh: 可以贡献给经济，但在遇到困难时却无人可帮的人表现得更好。

sentences.en: So there's a case to be made that family-based immigration, that having family ties when you're an immigrant arriving in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以有理由认为，基于家庭的移民，即作为一名移民抵达美国时拥有家庭纽带，

sentences.en: is actually a pretty strong form of merit.
sentences.zh: 实际上是一种非常强大的“能力”。

sentences.en: Absolutely, a strong case.
sentences.zh: 绝对，这是一个强有力的论点。

sentences.en: And that's something that could be incorporated into a merit-based system.
sentences.zh: 而且这也可以被纳入基于能力的体系中。

sentences.en: We could offer points based on who has family ties just like with the diversity visa that we've talked about.
sentences.zh: 我们可以像我们讨论过的多元化签证一样，根据谁拥有家庭纽带提供积分。

sentences.en: You know, you could offer points for diversity.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你可以为多元化提供积分。

sentences.en: These are all things that could be incorporated into a merit-based system in theory, but that's not what President Trump is talking about doing when he proposes his version
sentences.zh: 理论上，这些都可以纳入基于能力的体系，但那并不是特朗普总统在提出他的版本时

sentences.en: of a merit-based immigration system.
sentences.zh: 所谈论的内容。

sentences.en: So, Caitlin, what we're talking about would be a massive overhaul of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，凯特琳，我们所谈论的是对美国

sentences.en: immigration system.
sentences.zh: 移民体系的一次大规模重构。

sentences.en: Is this actually on the table right now?
sentences.zh: 这真的在当前的议程上吗？

sentences.en: It is on the table and it looks like it's going to have to be on the table because on Wednesday
sentences.zh: 它确实在议程上，而且看起来它必须在议程上，因为在周三，

sentences.en: President Trump came out and said that if whatever bill the Senate comes up with doesn't include this idea of merit-based immigration, that he'll veto it.
